How To Use This Target

Use native GMEOW terms as the authoring surface, then inspect the projection rows below to see which facts can leave GMEOW for this consumer vocabulary. Treat lossy notes as adoption warnings, not as implementation details.

Loss Notes

Profile Source Dropped Structure
sioc gmeow:EmailMessage RFC 5322 header structure (cc/bcc, address vs agent) flattens to SIOC's post model
sioc gmeow:FeedPosting the open posting-kind value (social/blog/microblog) flattens to SIOC's single Post class
sioc gmeow:from the address-vs-agent distinction collapses: the contact-point holder is read as the creator
sioc gmeow:hasContactPoint the address-vs-agent distinction collapses: the contact-point holder is read as the creator
sioc gmeow:holdsAccount every held online account over-types as a SIOC user account
